message.content: {"events":[{"event_id":"metaphase","caption":"Sister kinetochores attach to opposite spindle poles and the duplicated chromosome aligns at the metaphase plate.","process_ids":["bipolar_attachment"],"duration":6.0},{"event_id":"anaphase","caption":"Sister chromatid cohesion is released and the existing chromatids, now daughter chromosomes, move to opposite poles.","process_ids":["chromatid_separation"],"duration":6.0}],"scientific_simplifications":["One already-duplicated chromosome, not an entire genome or ploidy count.","Centromere/kinetochore and spindle are schematic; molecular cohesion cleavage not shown.","Same two physical chromatid objects persist, then are called daughter chromosomes after separation.","No DNA replication or homolog pairing occurs in this clip."]}
